title: Punjab and Haryana High Court (Justice Parmod Goyal; reported 12 Nov 2026 by LiveLaw and NewsX) holds no-fault compensation under Section 164 of the Motor Vehicles Act covers even an 'Act of God': four people grievously hurt when ice pushed a car into a gorge near Lakkar Mandi, Dalhousie, on 9 Mar 1997 get ₹2.5 lakh each with 6% interest from their claim dates (MACT Amritsar had dismissed all five claims in Mar 2004; appeals pending since 2004); the owner-driver's death claim fails (not a third party; his 1997 policy covered only a paid driver, no premium for the owner); Section 164 (in force 1 Apr 2022; ₹5 lakh death, ₹2.5 lakh grievous hurt) applied to the older accident
